text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Dovercourt Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate a "Commercial Loading Zone", on the east side of Dovercourt Road, to help facilitate a curb-side commercial loading/unloading of goods to the local business located at No. 963 Dovercourt Road (Vert Catering). The proposed commercial loading zone will operate from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, and will not eliminate any overnight permit parking spaces.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate a commercial loading zone to operate between 9:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Dovercourt Road, between a point 80.8 metres south of Hallam Street and a point 7 metres further south.
